flagged_clashes.en: Unit 4 has a flat roof (66" clear attic cavity) with an active leak hold: ZERO new roof penetrations. Furnace flue must exit horizontally out exterior sidewall per 2025 SFMC 802.8 (>= 4 ft from interior lot line).

flagged_clashes.en: Joist bay width B and overhead framing/wires/pipes are MEASURE ON SITE. Never shrink 24" x 36" finished clear.
flagged_clashes.es: Ancho de claro entre vigas B e instalaciones arriba: MEDIR EN OBRA. Nunca reducir el libre terminado de 24" x 36".
